title: Release one-pager
description: A single/album launch page in the monolith register — true black and white, monumental type, zero accent hue: a countdown to the release date computed from the content file (days/hours/minutes under "Out Friday", flipping to OUT NOW with listen links at midnight on the date), pre-save links, a title-track excerpt through the native waveform player, the tracklist, one click-to-load visual, and a mailing-list form. One page, launch-day ready.

forms.$comment: Managed-form kinds, formKey -> kind (append-only vocabulary: RSVP | LEAD | MAILING_LIST | PROOFING). Compose stamps these into repobot.deploy.json as formKinds; the dashboard renders declared kinds as typed views and keeps the raw Inbox for undeclared keys.

theme.$comment: The monolith register's overlay: mode dark opens the page in its native black (the appearance toggle still swaps to the gallery-white inversion — part of the art direction, not an accommodation), and the register's own inks ride as the project brand so app-side surfaces stay black-and-white instead of the kernel default blue. Values match monolith's text inks; accent resolves to ink-on-ground in both modes.

contentContract.$comment: The pack's content slots, as data (packs/README.md 'Content contract'). record.releaseDate is a plain ISO date — the page computes the countdown at render time and flips to OUT NOW after local midnight on the date; no edits on release day. The excerpt defaults to the bundled original loop; record.excerpt.embedUrl swaps the player to a click-to-load streaming embed.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware tail on a bespoke page: the masthead (countdown, listen rail), excerpt player, tracklist, and visual are the pack's bespoke surfaces; the kernel tail (about + mailing list) merges under page id 'home' (web/app/src/View/Single/SinglePage.tsx, useSitePageConfig), so the structural editor can reorder and extend the closing sections. style must ride the overlay; the preset is monolith — the severe register: strict black and white, display type past the scale ceiling, razor hairlines, the accent token resolving to ink-on-ground.
